title: Login and authentication troubleshooting
text: For login failures, first confirm the workspace identifier, then check Auth Service health. Error AUTH-401 indicates an expired access token; request a fresh token through the normal sign-in flow. Do not ask the user to share a password or token. Auth Service depends on Identity Database.

title: Atlas API rate limits
text: Atlas Standard allows 120 API requests per minute per workspace. HTTP 429 means the workspace rate limit was exceeded. Honor Retry-After and use bounded exponential backoff with jitter. Do not automatically retry an operation with side effects unless it supports an idempotency key.

title: Service status and ownership
text: Atlas API is owned by Platform Team and depends on Auth Service and Billing Service. Auth Service is owned by Identity Team. Billing Service is owned by Commerce Team. Identity Database is owned by Data Platform Team.

title: Duplicate billing and safe retries
text: If an invoice appears duplicated, retrieve both invoice identifiers and create a draft billing investigation. Do not charge, refund or delete an invoice automatically. The fake ticket API accepts an idempotency key and returns the same ticket for the same key and identical payload.

title: Support data retention
text: Atlas Support conversation notes are retained for 30 days in this fictional policy. Users may request deletion. An explicit deletion must remove the note from future memory retrieval. Operational backup retention is documented separately and is not specified here.

title: Data export formats
text: Workspace owners can export support reports as CSV or JSON. PDF export is not supported. Exports contain report data, not API tokens. The export endpoint is read-only and requires the workspace owner role.

title: Error XJ-41: billing dependency timeout
text: Error XJ-41 means Atlas API timed out waiting for Billing Service. Check Billing Service health and contact Commerce Team if the outage persists. A restart must be reviewed by the responsible operator; the support assistant may only propose a draft investigation.

title: Container deployment checklist
text: Before deployment, run the test suite, verify health and readiness probes, configure secrets outside the image and set resource limits. Roll back to the previous image revision if the new revision fails readiness. Do not commit credentials into a container image.
